melder.crystallizer.crystal_loader_syste.label: graft_runner
melder.crystallizer.crystal_loader_syste.role: Restore grain below the conduit slice: re-integrates one captured spell index into a live host book.
responsibilities: replay index membership, custody and selection through public verbs only
fresh index by default; explicit merge uses public bind/notch verbs without mutating index internals
preserves each member resolution capability through selected, parked and merged graft bindings

melder.crystallizer.crystal_loader_syste.label: GraftRunner
melder.crystallizer.crystal_loader_syste.role: Single-use spell-index graft executor: re-integrates one captured index (members, custody, selection) into a live conjured host book through normal verbs only.
responsibilities: gates the versioned graft record (RecordVersion MAJOR + graft_kind)
refuses unconjured hosts via the public Spellbook.conduit accessor
applies the resident-member rule via frame.find_index_for_spell; explicit merge grows the requested index through public verbs
hydrates members via the import lane with a rebuild-then-retry arc through user_world_rebuild
binds the selected member ACTIVE (fresh index) and parks the rest via bind_inactive
forwards ordered disposal names for every member and carries the new index directly to fresh-graft parking
adopts only a successfully grafted selected member using its returned live binding ID
emits a detached membership and index-identity report with explicit shortfalls
preserves each member resolution capability through selected, parked and merged graft bindings

hydrates each member's spellframe through the same rule as the restore engine (_hydrate_spellframe) at the selected, parked and merged bind sites, appending a shortfall when the recorded Protocol cannot be imported (0.2.8222)
replays a managed member's recorded options (record 4.2.0, SpellCrystal.managed_bind_options) at the selected, parked and merged bind sites (0.2.8242)
lets receiving-Book policy decide each member's binding, never its spell_id: a live spell_id differs from the recorded one only when the member's code moved since the record (0.2.8257)

files a merge member recorded under another binding than the merge target's (binding_signature) as the shortfall member_binding_differs_from_merge_target before bind_inactive, naming both bindings in the words the target's refusal uses and the remedy, so nothing of it is registered and the other members still park; a recorded selection refused that way is not adopted (2026-10-25)

edges_authored.why: the runner drives the host book's public verbs only: conduit accessor, bind (selected member, fresh index), bind_inactive (parked members).
member hydration failures retry once after rebuilding absent user modules through the shared retained-text lane.

an explicit merge reads the caller's index's binding (binding_signature and its refusal text) and files each member recorded another way as a shortfall before bind_inactive, so the index admits only members bound as its first version was (2026-10-25).
